critical_code_review_comments: clarity_ai.py — clean LlmChat wrapper. System prompt is well-authored (English-only, two-rooms aware, soft invite semantics). History is inline-formatted into the system message with a 16-turn cutoff — stateless SDK call per turn, which is the right choice given the session ciphertext storage. Defensive handling of .content/.text fallback is a nice touch.

clarity_tts.py — tight, minimal. VOICE_FOR_GENDER={'female':'coral','male':'echo'} matches founder spec. DEFAULT_MODEL='tts-1-hd' and DEFAULT_SPEED=0.92 are applied. TTS_MAX_CHARS=4000 (under OpenAI's 4096 cap). is_configured() correctly gates startup.

server.py /api/clarity/tts — good ETag-based 304 short-circuit BEFORE calling OpenAI (saves credits on browser re-asks). Auth-gated via _require_user. 503 on RuntimeError (no key) vs 500 on unexpected is appropriate. Cache-Control: private, max-age=86400 is correct — user-specific synthesis should not hit shared caches.
server.py /api/courses/{slug}/enroll — idempotent via find_one on (user_id, course_slug). uuid.uuid4() id + started_at ISO string + source='beta_grant'. Clean.

server.py /api/courses/{slug} detail — unlock math uses started_at + (day-1) days; day-1 always treated as preview. Defensive datetime.fromisoformat with try/except is fine. MINOR: imports 'datetime' via __import__ inline rather than using the top-level timedelta import — cosmetic, not a bug.

CLARITY_AI_ENABLED flag defaults to true and falls back to the curated _pick_prompt rotation if Claude raises — this is the right safety net so a transient Anthropic outage does not 500 the whole cabinet. Crisis detection still runs ahead of both paths so self-harm input always lands on CRISIS_RESPONSE. Verified.

MagicLinkRequest uses email: str (not EmailStr) — acceptable for this iteration but should be hardened with pydantic EmailStr once the email-validator dep is added; flagging only because it's in files_of_reference.
5 mp3 audio companions are served from /app/frontend/public/assets/audio/courses/ — frontend-build routing path, correct. File sizes 738KB–744KB, content-type audio/mpeg end-to-end.
test_credentials: Synthetic Mongo session per /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Backend tests use per-fixture ephemeral users with 'test-it27-' prefix — auto-cleaned (users, user_sessions, cabinet_sessions, body_insights, course_enrollments, clarity_user_prefs).
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral only — every user + session + cabinet_sessions + course_enrollments + body_insights row is purged in fixture teardown. No persistent seed changes.
